name: tvtcommerce/module-login-rate-limiter
description: Free Magento 2 storefront security extension — rate-limits customer login attempts PER IP ADDRESS, independent of whether the submitted email exists. Additive to (never a replacement for) core's own per-account lockout (customer/password/lockout_threshold, customer/password/lockout_failures), which only tracks failures once a submitted email resolves to a real customerId and therefore never sees an attacker cycling through many different/nonexistent emails from the same IP.
